title: Responsive Image & Lazy Loading Testing — Runnable Companion
title_es: Casos de Prueba de Imágenes Responsive y Lazy Load — Companion Ejecutable
description: HTML fixture exercising srcset/sizes selection, picture art direction, eager/LCP vs lazy loading, preload with imagesrcset, and a broken-image case — plus a Playwright 1.48 spec and a pytest 8.3 suite asserting the fixture's markup contracts for the cases on qapractices.com.
description_es: Fixture HTML que ejercita selección srcset/sizes, art direction con picture, carga eager/LCP vs lazy, preload con imagesrcset y un caso de imagen rota — más una spec Playwright 1.48 y una suite pytest 8.3 que afirma los contratos de markup del fixture para los casos de qapractices.com.
